CustomField.label: Display: Found Formula
CustomField.description: Optional and display only - it never affects pass/fail. A formula, evaluated on the current record, whose result is shown as the "Found" value on the result row (the left side of the comparison - what the record has). Write fixed values in formula syntax: text in double quotes ("Cold"), numbers bare (100), TRUE or FALSE, dates as DATE(2025,1,31). Its return type is set by "Formula Result Type". Leave blank for no Found value. Example: BLANKVALUE(Debit_Total__c, 0).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Display only (not pass/fail). Formula for the "Found" value shown on the row, e.g. BLANKVALUE(Debit_Total__c, 0). Fixed values use formula syntax ("Cold", 100, TRUE). Blank = no Found value.
